_meta.bed: local ERPNext dev bed, v15.94.3 (frappe 15.96.0), Standard chart of accounts, IDR
_meta.about: ECX5-T0: Fiscal Year create, overlap and lookup
_meta.names: synthetic: company "ECX Probe Co" (abbr EPC), parties and employees named "ECX Probe ..." / "Probe ...", bed users replaced by role labels

apiUsers.apiUserWithSystemManager: token-auth API user holding the 901-bot role set (Accounts Manager/User, Purchase Manager/User, Stock Manager/User, Sales Manager/User, Projects Manager/User, System Manager) plus HR Manager/User and, from the Supplier probe on, Purchase Master Manager
apiUsers.apiUserWithoutSystemManager: same roles minus System Manager (and without Purchase Master Manager)

notes: POST /api/resource/Fiscal Year {year, year_start_date, year_end_date, companies:[{company}]}; name = year. A year with no companies rows is global (the bed has global years 2026 and 2027).
Create needs System Manager: a user with Accounts Manager but without System Manager gets 403 PermissionError. Read works for both.

Refused: end before start (417 InvalidDates), not one year (417 InvalidDates "should be one year after", unless is_short_year=1), duplicate name (409 DuplicateEntryError), missing year name (417 ValidationError "Year Name is required"), unknown company row (417 LinkValidationError).

Overlap: a new year whose dates overlap an existing year is refused with 409 NameError "Year start date or end date is overlapping with <year>. To avoid please set company" when it has no company rows OR shares a company with the other year; identical start+end dates are refused with 417 ValidationError "... are already set in Fiscal Year <year>" even for a different company. A partial overlap for a DIFFERENT company, with company rows on both, is accepted.

Lookup: filtering through the child table finds only company-scoped years; a global year has no child row. Use a date-range filter (year_start_date <= d and year_end_date >= d) and check the companies child rows, not the child-table filter alone.
Posting into a date with no covering year is refused at SUBMIT with FiscalYearError (see openingEntry.json).
_meta.v16: differs: overlap rules looser (identical dates for another company, company-scoped year beside a global year); HTML link in the overlap message

v16.bed: local ERPNext dev bed, v16: erpnext 16.53.0, frappe 16.54.0, Standard chart of accounts, IDR (same probe sets as the v15 cases)
notes: v16 is MORE permissive than v15: a year for one company may have identical dates to a year of another company (v15: 417 "already set in Fiscal Year"), and a company-scoped year may sit beside a global year (identical dates v15: 417; v16 200; a partial overlap with a global year is also 200).

Unchanged: a year that overlaps another year sharing the same company -> 409 NameError "Year start date or end date is overlapping with <link>. To avoid please set company"; a new global year (no company rows) overlapping any year -> 409; end<start, not-one-year, duplicate name, missing name, unknown company: same statuses. Create without System Manager: 403 in both. Non-calendar and short years accepted in both.
The overlap message now carries an HTML link: "...overlapping with Fiscal Year ECX 2031. To avoid please set company".

The v16 bed has global years 2026, 2027 and 2028 (v15 bed: 2026, 2027). Lookup by date range plus an inspection of the companies child rows works the same; the company child filter still misses global years.

A partial overlap between years of two different companies is accepted on v16 as on v15 (case "partial overlap OTHER company vs company-scoped year only", status 200); the main-run 409 on that label came from also overlapping the same-company year "ECX 2031 d" and is not a version difference.

Error text: v16 sends _server_messages as compact JSON with an extra "as_table": false key per message; the parsed message text and exc_type/status are what the cases compare. HTML links in messages point at /desk/... (v15: /app/...).
GL Entry list order is not stable across versions; compare rows by content, not position.
Another company on the v16 bed supplied the "other company" cases (named Other Co here).
